select p.FINPROD_ID id, p.FINPROD_ABBR text from FIN_PRODUCT p
1=1
and FINPROD_TYPE =#{finprodType}
AND (FINPROD_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR FINPROD_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
select count(1) from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ null outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ deal.BOOKSET_ID portfolioId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME portfolioName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR finprodName,/**资产名称**/ t.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, /**金融产品类型**/ case when t.PS = 'T01' and t.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F01' THEN '01' when t.PS = 'T02' and t.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F01' THEN '02' when t.PS = 'T07' and t.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F08' THEN '03' ELSE '04' END AS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ t.SETTLE_DATE settDate,/**交割日期**/ mst.COUNTER_NAME counterId, /**交易对手**/ t.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, /**本金金额**/ t.INT_AMT intAmt,/**应收利息**/ stl.SETTLE_AMT settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ t.TRADE_AMT dealAmt,/**本币交易金额**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO trdAcctId/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY mst on mst.COUNTER_ID = t.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE ='01' where t.BUSI_TYPE ='01'
and t.TRADE_ID like concat(concat('%',#{tradeId}),'%')
and deal.BOOKSET_ID IN
#{portfolioId}
and t.TRADE_DATE >= to_date(#{tradeDateBegin},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and t.TRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{tradeDateEnd},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND t.PS IN
#{ps01}
AND t.FINPROD_TYPE IN
#{finprodType}
order by t.TRADE_ID desc

SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ null outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ deal.BOOKSET_ID portfolioId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME portfolioName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR finprodName,/**资产名称**/ t.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, /**金融产品类型**/ case when t.PS = 'T01' and t.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F01' THEN '01' when t.PS = 'T02' and t.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F01' THEN '02' when t.PS = 'T07' and t.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F08' THEN '03' ELSE '04' END AS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ t.SETTLE_DATE settDate,/**交割日期**/ zc.VDATE vdate,/**起息日**/ zc.MDATE mdate,/**到期日**/ mst.COUNTER_NAME counterId, /**交易对手**/ t.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, /**本金金额**/ t.INT_AMT intAmt,/**应收利息**/ stl.SETTLE_AMT settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ t.TRADE_AMT dealAmt,/**本币交易金额**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO trdAcctId/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY mst on mst.COUNTER_ID = t.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE ='01' where t.BUSI_TYPE ='01' and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rownum=1
